messages:
tanya (People Ops): Heads-up: Jordan submitted resignation. Final day 2026-05-01. Need to confirm COBRA timeline, 401(k) options, final expenses, and access removals.

sam (Manager): Confirmed 5/1. Can we do exit interview week prior? Prefer 4/29 AM.

people-ops-bot: Exit interview proposed: 2026-04-29 10:00 PT. Tanya to confirm.

tanya (People Ops): Locking 4/29 10:00 PT. Jordan, do you want the interview recorded (confidential notes only)?

jordan (Employee): Not recorded, but happy to do a short call.

payroll (Payroll): Reminder: final paycheck requires approved timesheet + termination form by EOD 2026-04-30. PTO paid out per policy. Any moving expenses/reimbursement requests?

jordan (Employee): I have last-month travel receipts (~$120). Will upload to Expensify today.

benefits-team (Benefits): COBRA packet will be generated on termination date and must be sent within 14 days. Coverage end date is 2026-05-01 (last day). State note: CA requires mail + email for COBRA notice. We need preferred mailing address.

jordan (Employee): Mail to 45 Castro St, Apt 3, Mountain View, CA 94041. Email: jordan.smith+alum@gmail.com

benefits-team (Benefits): Noted. Also: 401(k) plan vendor requires a separate form for rollover/loan options. We will email the vendor form within 7 business days. Let us know if you want a meeting with our benefits rep.

jordan (Employee): A quick call would be helpful. Thanks.

it-support (IT): Proposed access schedule:

- 2026-05-01 08:00 PT: revoke production roles and AWS console access
- 2026-05-01 17:00 PT: disable primary Okta account and Google Workspace

Do you need any exceptions?

sam (Manager): Keep GitHub access until 5/1 EOD so Jordan can finish patch reviews. Revoke CI tokens earlier at 08:00.

it-support (IT): Got it. We'll remove deploy keys and CI tokens 08:00 PT and leave GitHub org membership until EOD.

security (Security): Any VPN or vendor credentials shared with Jordan? Please list. We'll rotate secrets as needed.
sam (Manager): Jordan had crossbeam vendor login and a shared PagerDuty escalation key. I'll file change requests.

jordan (Employee): I've transferred ownership of two shared Google Docs to priya@redwood.ai and moved project checklist to #eng-runtime repo issues.

it-support (IT): For asset return: laptop (MacBook Pro 14), power adapter, dongle, and external SSD. Please either drop at HQ reception or request a prepaid label. Assets should be scanned into asset inventory.
jordan (Employee): Dropping at reception on 5/1 at 11:30.

people-ops-bot: Asset return reminder scheduled: 2026-05-01 09:00 PT.

benefits-team (Benefits): Quick Q: Jordan, do you have dependents on the plan? That affects COBRA cost info we send.
jordan (Employee): Yes, spouse covered.

benefits-team (Benefits): Noted. We'll include family coverage and cost estimates.

payroll (Payroll): Also note: final expense reimbursement (Expensify) cutoff is 5 business days after termination to include in final payroll.

jordan (Employee): Uploaded receipts and tagged expense report as "final".

security (Security): We'll rotate PagerDuty key and update incident runbook owners. Sam, please confirm new on-call owner.
sam (Manager): Emily will take PagerDuty ownership starting 5/1.

it-support (IT): For audit trail we'll run these commands on 2026-05-01 08:00 PT:

```
oktactl deactivate --user jordan@redwood.ai --time 2026-05-01T08:00:00-07:00
aws iam remove-user-policy --userName jordan
github-admin remove-member jordan --org redwood-ai
```

people-ops-bot: COBRA packet queued for 2026-05-01. 401(k) vendor email queued.

tanya (People Ops): Final checklist I'm tracking:
- Timesheet & termination form (payroll)
- COBRA notice + mailing address (benefits)
- 401(k) rollover form (benefits)
- Asset return scanned (IT)
- Prod roles revoked & deploy tokens rotated (security/IT)
- Knowledge transfer notes in #eng-runtime (manager)

sam (Manager): I'll post handover doc and outstanding PR list by 2026-04-28.

jordan (Employee): Appreciate the smooth process. Happy to help with any follow-ups after 5/1 via alumni email.

tanya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. Closing loop here; will update thread once COBRA/401(k) vendor confirm sent. :white_heart:
